rootCause: The production collector page confirmed the mint and then launched refresh work without awaiting a fresh post-mint storage read. The proof bridge could therefore serve its cached pre-mint projection while the page independently refreshed balance/supply, leaving wallet-limit state stale on the same page.

correction.production: After mint confirmation, clear wallet-status cache, await balance refresh, await contract refresh, recompute the active stage, force-await wallet-limit status, then continue reveal/success handling. Remove the final fire-and-forget refresh.
correction.proofBridge: Project storage dynamically from Shadownet on every browser read instead of returning the bootstrap snapshot.
correction.regression: The actual exported-page test deliberately caches stale stage_minted after mint, delays the fresh projectStorage result, and requires the 1/1 wallet-limit text to be present at the instant mint success is rendered. It also exercises the Taquito-real composite key object shape.
